metadata.description: Give Claude a video input and a video editor. /watch downloads, extracts frames, transcribes, and hands it all to Claude. /edit trims, merges, compresses, and more, locally via ffmpeg.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Watch a video (URL or local path) with /watch, and edit a local one with /edit. /watch downloads with yt-dlp, extracts frames with ffmpeg, transcribes via captions or Whisper. /edit trims, merges, compresses, watermarks, burns in subtitles, converts to GIF, and more, purely via local ffmpeg.
